summary: iter12 — Odoo service-token management feature tested end-to-end (backend + admin UI). Cleared db.odoo_service_tokens at test start for deterministic state. 21/21 pytest backend tests passed (incl. auth gating, generate, 409-on-re-generate, rotate, env-token revocation, previous-token revocation, /odoo/health.webhook_configured). Admin UI verified: token-manager mounts, masked preview shown, rotate flow → confirm dialog → reveal modal → toggle masked/full → copy → dismiss wipes raw token from DOM. Non-admin seller is redirected away from /admin and never sees the Odoo tab or token-manager. No production bugs found. Final DB state: 1 active DB-managed token + 2 historical rotated-out records (so the admin UI continues to show 'database / Active').
critical_code_review_comments: odoo_token_manager.py is clean: SHA-256 hash storage, hmac.compare_digest constant-time comparison, env fallback only triggered when no active DB record exists — exactly as spec. No raw token or hash ever leaks via /service-token GET.
odoo_routes.py verify_admin_only correctly refuses the X-JubaSquare-Odoo-Token header (admin-JWT-only) — a leaked service token cannot rotate itself. Confirmed by tests 11/42.
Frontend AdminOdooTokenManager.jsx: handleDismissReveal nulls out revealedToken (raw token gone from React state). DOM check after dismiss confirmed the reveal-token-value node disappears.

Minor (non-blocking): /api/odoo/health is public (no auth) and exposes 'webhook_configured: true|false'. This is intentional/spec-compliant but worth noting it leaks the configured-status to anonymous callers.

Minor (non-blocking): seller@demo.com / customer@demo.com / driver@demo.com listed in /app/memory/test_credentials.md do NOT exist in this env (login returns 401). Testing agent had to seed a temporary verified seller user (test_seller_iter12@demo.com) and deleted it on teardown. Recommend either re-seeding the demo accounts or updating memory/test_credentials.md.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@LTG.com / Kokobleake1 (works). seller@demo.com / Demo1234!|1234 — NOT present in this env, login 401. Workaround: seeded test_seller_iter12@demo.com / TestPass1234! directly via motor for the non-admin gating test, then deleted on teardown.
seed_data_creation: Cleared db.odoo_service_tokens at module setup. Seeded then removed a verified seller user (test_seller_iter12@demo.com). Final state: 1 active DB-managed Odoo service token in place so the user can immediately use the admin UI without re-generating.
context_for_next_testing_agent: If demo accounts (seller@demo.com, customer@demo.com, driver@demo.com) are restored by the main agent, replace the test_seller_iter12@demo.com fallback in test_iter12_odoo_token_mgmt.py::SELLER_CREDS. Tests are idempotent — the module-level fixture wipes the token collection at start, so re-running this suite is safe and always finishes with one active rotated DB token. iter11 regression list (product upsert stock+stock_quantity, category_id 422, seller_id auto-derive) was not re-run but the underlying auth model still routes through token_manager.verify(), so behavior should be unchanged. Token endpoint path is /api/admin/odoo/service-token (singular). Raw token shape: 64-char lowercase hex (secrets.token_hex(32)). Masked preview format: 12 '*' + last-4 chars.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bug found. Feature behaves exactly per the security model in the request.
